judgments.reason: The Zenodo record (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19599465) is the dataset's own deposit. It matches the dataset's authors, chronic MCA stroke patients plus healthy controls, 1000 Hz EEG and motor imagery.
judgments.paper_title: Mu and Beta Oscillatory Changes during a motor task following Rehabilitation in Chronic MCA Stroke: Insights from EEG
judgments.paper_venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used in dataset curation; it does not describe this stroke motor-imagery EEG dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a data-organization standard extension to BIDS, used to format this dataset, not a paper describing the stroke motor-imagery dataset.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography

judgments.reason: Same group and chronic stroke EEG, but the paper is a resting-state theta biomarker pilot study, whereas this dataset is mu/beta motor-imagery EEG; no evidence it describes this data.
judgments.paper_title: Resting-State Theta Oscillations as Biomarkers of Adaptive Neuroplasticity in Chronic Stroke: A Pilot EEG Study
